historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: mature-state terminal growth. Revenue 3yr CAGR 3.2% but FY2025 was flat (+0.03%) and H1 2026 fell 4.1% (VAT item adjustments, lower handset/goods sales, industry growth-driver shift); equity 3yr CAGR 2.2% corroborates a low-single-digit mature business.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (4.9%) is inflated by the FY2021 A-share IPO (share capital 80,932m -> 91,507m, ~RMB54bn raised) and understated by the 75% payout; it is not an organic compounding rate. EPS CAGR (6-7%) exceeds revenue CAGR because operating margin expanded 7.0% -> 7.5% and the tax rate fell; that margin tailwind has stalled in FY2025-H1 2026.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the Metrics CSV FCF (OCF less cash capex) less interest income (SBC nil) at both ends; lease principal is not deducted in the historical series because the full history of lease payments was not extracted, so the levels are above owner FCF but the growth rates are on a consistent basis. Owner FCF (company-definition FCF on accrual capex, less interest/investment income received, less lease principal) FY2025 = RMB24,730m vs company-reported RMB44,705m and CSV RMB51,954m.

scenario_narratives.base: Revenue falls 3.5% in FY2026: H1 2026 printed -4.1% as the Jan-2026 VAT reclassification (6% -> 9% on mobile data, SMS and broadband) permanently cut net revenue by ~1.5-2% on top of mobile ARPU pressure in a saturated market (130 subscriptions per 100 people) and shrinking handset sales. Growth grinds back to ~2% from FY2028 as Tianyi Cloud (RMB120.7bn, #2 IaaS in China), AIDC/computing-power services (8 GW capacity, 118.8 EFLOPS) and 5G-A/FTTR upgrades offset legacy decline; the Intelligence Business (12.8% of principal revenue in H1 2026, +7.1%) keeps missing the 20% mix target but grows. EBITDA margin resets to 26.0% in FY2026 (H1 2026 -1.2pp YoY) and recovers to 27.0% through AI-enabled cost control (H1 2026 opex -2.2%), never fully recouping the VAT step. Accrual capex follows the ~RMB73bn FY2026 guidance (14.2%) and tapers to 13.5%; China Tower lease cost held at 3.4%. Cash tax ramps from 16% to the 22% effective rate. The 75% payout (RMB24.9bn FY2025; interim DPS cut 11.4% with profit) continues; retained FCF and the ~RMB140bn surplus financial assets are credited at face.
scenario_narratives.bull: The VAT step laps in FY2027 and Industrial Digitalisation / AI monetisation (Token operations, TeleAgent, Xirang platform, Intelligence Business mix climbing toward the 20% target) return group revenue to 3% growth from FY2028 while the handset drag washes out; margin rebuilds to 28.0% as AI replaces labour and network-sharing with China Unicom deepens. Capex falls to 12.5% of revenue, lease cost edges down as tower-sharing terms improve, preferential tax regimes persist (20% cash rate), and the payout keeps rising above 75%, which is the trigger for the H-share discount and the 63% A/H premium to narrow. Terminal growth 2.5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: The FY2026 revenue decline (-5.5%) extends: the VAT step is followed by further regulator-driven tariff cuts, mobile and broadband ARPU erode in three-way price competition, goods sales keep shrinking, and Industrial Digitalisation growth stalls with a receivables build (FY2025 OCF -13.8% for that reason) that the margin path absorbs. AIDC capex (35% of the budget, built to national-policy mandates rather than demonstrated demand, against Alibaba/Tencent/Huawei Cloud) keeps capex at 14.5-15% with depreciation rising against under-utilised computing assets, EBITDA margin compresses to 24.5%, lease cost ticks up to 3.5%, and preferential tax regimes roll off toward the 25% statutory rate. Terminal growth 1%. The cash pile is still credited, so the bear is a margin-and-capex case, not a solvency case; consensus (CLSA -20% profit cuts, Goldman HKD4.20 Sell) sits closer to this path than to the base.

valuation_philosophy.summary: China Telecom is a mature, cash-generative, state-controlled carrier: ~RMB40bn of owner FCF a year after China Tower rentals, negligible debt, and roughly RMB140bn of cash, deposits, structured deposits and the China Tower stake net of group deposits and NCI. The H-share at HKD 4.685 (RMB 3.99) values the equity at ~RMB365bn, so the operating business is being bought for ~RMB225bn, about 5.9x FY1 owner FCF (RMB223bn / RMB38bn) and <2x pre-IFRS-16 EBITDA, on a 6.8% dividend yield. The house DCF (12x terminal cap, 9% RMB WACC) says the stock is worth far more than that, and the gap is almost entirely a governance/trapped-cash discount: a dividend-only model at the same 9% required return (RMB0.272 x 1.02 / 0.07 = RMB3.96 = HKD4.66) lands on the current price, i.e. the market gives zero credit for retained FCF or the cash hoard. The thesis therefore rests on (1) the 75%-and-rising payout policy, (2) capex continuing to fall as 5G build matures, and (3) the A/H premium (A-share RMB6.49 = HKD7.62) narrowing. Weighted value should be read as the owner's-economics value; the entry price at the 15% hurdle is the price at which the governance discount is paid for. No-re-rate memo: holding the terminal exit at today's ~5.9x owner FCF instead of the 12x cap takes the base value to roughly HKD6.95, so about HKD1.6/share of the HKD8.54 base value is the re-rating assumption and the remaining upside over the price is the bridge (cash, deposits, structured deposits and China Tower stake).
key_risks_to_valuation: Trapped-cash / governance risk: 70% state parent, Finance Company recycles group cash, capex and pricing follow national policy -- surplus assets credited at face in the bridge may never reach minority holders beyond the 75% payout.

VAT regime: the 2026 reclassification to 9% is modelled as permanent; a further reclassification (e.g. of cloud/ICT services) or renewed 'cut tariffs' campaigns would take another step out of net revenue with no cost offset. Government revenue needs can hit earnings with no appeal.
Revenue decline persisting beyond FY2026: H1 2026 -4.1%; saturated mobile market, regulator-driven tariff cuts, shrinking handset sales.
AIDC/computing-power capex overbuild: depreciation and capex stay elevated against under-utilised data-centre assets; bear case carries capex at 14.5-15%.
Industrial Digitalisation receivables: FY2025 OCF fell 13.8% on a ~RMB15bn receivables build; conversion of EBITDA to cash is the weakest link in the component build.
Cash tax normalisation: 14% cash rate vs 22% effective and 25% statutory; loss of western-region/high-tech preferential rates would cost ~RMB3-4bn/yr.
China Tower lease cost: 3.4% of revenue; a re-pricing of the tower services agreement moves owner FCF ~RMB5bn per 1pp.
FX: RMB-denominated value translated at CNY/HKD 1.1747; a 5% RMB depreciation is a 5% hit in HKD terms, and refresh_price.py does not update fx_rate.
Implied multiple expansion: the 12x terminal cap is ~2x the ~5.9x multiple the H-share trades on today; the required_return_table shows value at 15% still above the price only because of the bridge.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API for 0728.HK at inputs.price_as_of (HKD); 52-week range 4.24-6.08. FX from Yahoo HKDCNY=X on 2026-10-11; A-share parity from 601728.SS same source.
data_sources.financials: 0728.HK_Metrics.csv (FY2017-FY2025 annual, H1 2024-2026 interims, RMB millions) from core_metrics; component lines from 0728.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt (cash-flow statement lines 8143-8238, lease note 8164/11248, ROU depreciation 9802, Finance Company deposits 12292, dividend table 4225-4235, MD&A 1834-1906) and 0728.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt (balance sheet 2369-2466, cash-flow statement 2670-2712, MD&A 1174-1270).
data_sources.qualitative: 0728.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-11): VAT reclassification, FY2026 capex guidance ~RMB73bn, Intelligence Business mix, consensus/broker moves; plus FY2025 annual report chairman's statement and MD&A and H1 2026 interim report sections III-IV (strategy, AIDC/Xirang/Token operations, financial review).

inputs.share_count_basis: 91,507m ordinary shares (A + H) at 30 June 2026, interim note 20: diluted EPS equals basic because there are no potential ordinary shares outstanding. Held FLAT: SBC is nil and there is no non-SBC issuance planned.
inputs.sbc_source: unavailable at group level; FY2025 AR line 12657 shows share-based payments nil (FY2024: RMB659m, a cash-settled share-appreciation-rights scheme already inside personnel expenses). Treated as zero: SBC-zero market, house and street bases coincide.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); H-share quote in HKD. Yahoo HKDCNY=X 0.8513 on 2026-10-11, so CNY->HKD = 1/0.8513 = 1.1747 (fx_rate is model->quote). Dual-listing check: A-share 601728.SS closed CNY 6.49 on 2026-10-09 = HKD 7.62 at this rate versus the H-share 4.685 -- a 63% A/H premium, which is the normal state-owned-telecom A/H gap rather than an FX error; the H-share is the line being valued. Rate must be refreshed with the price (refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate).
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in RMB: China 10y CGB ~1.8% + China ERP ~6.5% x telecom beta ~0.7 gives a CAPM cost of equity near 6.5%; house uses 9.0% to carry state-owned-enterprise governance risk (70% parent, cash retained beyond the 75% payout, capex directed by national policy) in the discount rate ONCE. Debt is 1% of capital so WACC ~= cost of equity. The same 9.0% is used in every scenario; cyclical and execution risk lives in the driver paths, not in per-scenario WACC.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: full lease cash (FY2025 principal RMB16,792m, AR line 8164, plus lease interest RMB1,480m, AR line 11248 = RMB18,272m, 3.45% of revenue) charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (RMB38,561m at 30 Jun 2026) EXCLUDED from net debt; D&A for cash tax is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 RMB104,198m less ROU depreciation RMB16,916m, AR line 9802 = RMB87,282m = 16.5% of revenue). The leases are overwhelmingly China Tower site rentals, a perpetual operating cost, so treatment (B) is the economically honest one. last_fcf deducts the FY2025 lease principal for the same reason.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests RMB7,520m (30 Jun 2026) deducted once in the equity bridge; flows are left whole. NCI share of profit is immaterial (RMB38m FY2025).
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component route, 10-year horizon, with the non-US adaptations (RMB flows/HKD quote, lease treatment B, NCI in bridge, matching-asset rule, SBC-zero). Chosen because China Telecom is a capital-intensive operating carrier whose value is a stream of free cash flow; it is not a bank (3328.HK is Bank of Communications). OWNER FCF BASE: reported FCF on the company's own definition (OCF RMB125,069m less ACCRUAL capex RMB80,364m = RMB44,705m, AR line 743; the Metrics CSV's RMB51,954m uses the cash capex line RMB73,115m, the gap being payables timing) less interest received RMB735m and investment income received RMB2,448m (both sit inside operating cash flow and both source assets are credited in the bridge) less lease principal RMB16,792m = RMB24,730m (4.7% of revenue). The component-built FY1 owner-FCF margin (~7.5%) sits above that because FY2025 OCF carried a ~RMB15bn receivables build from Industrial Digitalisation (MD&A: OCF -13.8% for that reason) which H1 2026 shows reversing (OCF +30%, 'increase in accounts receivable effectively controlled'); if the receivables build is structural rather than timing, the bear case is the right lens. NET CASH AND BRIDGE: inputs.cash is cash & equivalents only (RMB40,657m); the remaining surplus financial assets and debt-like claims are itemised in equity_bridge so each can be audited: + bank deposits and restricted cash RMB29,643m current + RMB5,964m long-term, + financial assets at FVTPL RMB33,372m current + RMB20,724m non-current (the MD&A says bank deposits were converted into low-risk structured deposits whose yield is booked as investment income -- hence investment income is stripped from the flows), + interests in associates and JVs RMB47,094m at book (China Tower ~20.5% stake dominates; its share of profit RMB2,674m is outside EBITDA so the asset must be in the bridge), - deposits placed by the China Telecom parent group with the listed company's Finance Company plus entrusted loans from the group (RMB27,100m + RMB2,011m at 31 Dec 2025 per AR line 12292, less the RMB9,449m net withdrawal in H1 2026 per interim cash-flow line 2706 = ~RMB19,662m, a funding liability against the cash we are crediting), - NCI RMB7,520m. Lease liabilities are deliberately NOT in the bridge (treatment B). FVOCI equity instruments (RMB3,715m) left out for conservatism. CAPEX is modelled on the accrual figure (FY2025 RMB80,364m, 15.2% of revenue; H1 2026 RMB32,448m, -5.2% YoY) not the cash line (RMB73,115m), because the gap is payables timing. CASH TAX: FY2025 cash tax RMB5,483m is 14% of lease-adjusted EBIT against a 22.2% effective P&L rate (statutory 25%, western-region and high-tech subsidiaries at 15%, untaxed China Tower income, R&D super-deduction) with deferred tax liabilities still growing; H1 2026 cash tax RMB4,513m (vs 3,339m) shows the ramp has started, so the path ramps 16% -> 22%. WORKING CAPITAL capture set to 0 in all scenarios: revenue is roughly flat so the change term is small, and the receivables risk is carried in the bear margin path instead. SBC-zero: band_position is null, house == street. VAT: MOF/STA Announcement No.9 of 2026 reclassified mobile data, SMS/MMS and broadband access from 6% to 9% VAT from 1 Jan 2026 (Analysis JSON, recent_developments); revenue is booked net of VAT so this is a permanent ~1.5-2% step-down in net revenue that falls straight through to EBITDA (H1 2026 EBITDA margin 28.5% vs 29.7% in H1 2025; EBITDA -7.7% YoY). FY2026 margins are set off that run-rate, not off FY2025. Capex guidance FY2026 ~RMB73bn (-9.2%), per the March 2026 results briefing cited in the Analysis JSON, = 14.2% of modelled FY2026 revenue. IMPLIED RE-RATING: at HKD4.685 the equity is ~RMB365bn and, after the ~RMB142bn bridge, the operating business trades at ~RMB223bn, roughly 5.9x FY1 owner FCF; the model's terminal cap of 12x therefore assumes multiple expansion, which valuation_philosophy states and the no-re-rate memo quantifies.
inputs.price_volatility_note: Regular Friday close, not after-hours; no flag.

base.growth_note: FY2026 -3.5%: H1 2026 printed -4.1% (VAT reclassification ~-1.7% mechanical plus falling handset/goods sales and mobile ARPU pressure); the VAT effect runs through all of 2026 so H2 is modelled -2.9% against the RMB258.1bn H2 2025 base. FY2027 +0.5% as the VAT step laps, then ~2% as Tianyi Cloud / AIDC / 5G-A offset legacy decline.
base.margin_note: FY2025 reported EBITDA margin 27.2% (post-IFRS-16). H1 2026 fell 1.2pp YoY to 28.5% (H1 is seasonally high) on the permanent VAT step-down, so FY2026 is set at 26.0%; drifts to 27.0% on AI-driven cost control (H1 2026 opex -2.2%, personnel -2.1%, network ops -1.5%) without ever recovering the VAT loss. Lease cost 3.4% of revenue charged separately.
base.capex_note: FY2026 guided ~RMB73bn (-9.2% YoY) = 14.2% of modelled revenue, with AI computing power ~35% of the budget; tapers to 13.5% as 5G build matures and AIDC spending is funded within a shrinking envelope per management's 'demand-driven, returns-focused' language.
base.tax_note: Cash tax 14% of lease-adjusted EBIT in FY2025 ramping to the 22% effective rate as deferred tax liabilities stop growing; statutory 25% not reached because western-region/high-tech 15% rates and R&D super-deductions are structural.
base.terminal_note: Cap 12x owner FCF binds (Gordon at 9%/2% is 14.6x). 12x is itself a re-rating from the ~5-6x EV/owner-FCF the H-share trades on; see valuation_philosophy.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30% because FY2026 is a confirmed revenue-decline year, the company is a policy-directed state-owned enterprise whose capex and pricing are not set for minority shareholders, and the house value depends on crediting ~RMB140bn of surplus financial assets that management has so far retained rather than returned. Bull trimmed to 20% because it needs three independent things (AI/cloud revenue acceleration, margin expansion and a higher payout) to go right together. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
